item.title: Fix groom returning success on jq parse failure
item.intent: When jq parsing fails after a groom operation and the snapshot is restored, the function must signal failure so callers know the groom did not succeed.
steps: Open .aishore/lib/cmd-groom.sh and find the jq parse failure handler (~lines 88-91)
Change return 0 to return 1 in the jq parse failure block
Verify callers of this function handle the failure return correctly

acceptanceCriteria.text: Function returns 1 when jq parsing fails after groom
